survival_target.note: Follow-up is administratively censored at 36 months, matching the pfs_36m label. PFS_MONTHS is a target, never a feature.

c_index_note: C-index is Harrell's concordance over comparable pairs of (PFS_MONTHS, PFS_STATUS). A censored patient is only ever the later member of a pair. Time and event are targets, never features.
note: Y=1 is progression by 36 months. Patients censored earlier are dropped. PFS months define the window and are not features.
